description.en: Sidebar management surface: hard-delete archived sessions and archived workspaces, move sessions between workspaces, and fork a session into a new project workspace, all through journaled two-phase transactions with rollback, safety guards and a promotion gate.
description.zh: 侧边栏管理面板：通过带日志的两阶段事务，配合回滚、安全护栏和提升闸门，实现归档会话与归档工作区的彻底删除、会话跨工作区移动，以及把会话分叉为新项目工作区。
